'''Vladimir Pešić''' (born 1973)<ref>{{Cite web |title=AUT - Úplné zobrazení záznamu |url=https://aleph.nkp.cz/F/?func=find-c&local_base=aut&ccl_term=ica=jcu20231189355 |access-date=2024-04-01 |website=aleph.nkp.cz}}</ref> is a [[scientist]] from [[Montenegro]], and a [[biologist]] who is an expert on [[Hydrachnidiae]], the water [[mite]]s. He is also a co-author [[taxon authority]] for a new species of [[freshwater snail]] (''[[Valvata montenegrina]])'' Glöer & Pešić, 2008 ([[Valvatidae]], [[Gastropoda]]). Pešić works in the Department of Biology at the [[University of Montenegro]], at [[Podgorica]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.sci.muni.cz/botdokt/doc/symposiummontenegro.doc |title=3rd INTERNATIONAL SYMPOSIUM OF ECOLOGISTS OF MONTENEGRO |access-date=2012-11-03 |archive-date=2016-03-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304032352/http://www.sci.muni.cz/botdokt/doc/symposiummontenegro.doc |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.leksikon.me/ucg.ac.me/naucni-radovi/97-autori/406-pesic-vladimir |title=List of publications |access-date=2012-11-03 |archive-date=2020-04-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200422203542/http://www.leksikon.me/ucg.ac.me/naucni-radovi/97-autori/406-pesic-vladimir |url-status=dead }}</ref> He is editor of the journal ''[[Ecologica Montenegrina]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://biotaxa.org/em/about/editorialTeam |title=Editorial Team|journal=Ecologica Montenegrina|access-date=2024-05-08}}</ref>
<ref>https://orcid.org/0000-0002-9724-345X</ref><ref>https://sciprofiles.com/profile/968137</ref><ref>https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=KdCHuTUAAAAJ&hl=en</ref><ref>http://entomologytoday.org/tag/vladimir-pesic/</ref>

Pešić, along with his team, has discovered a new species of ''Litarachna'' in [[Puerto Rico]] and named it ''Litarachna lopezae'', after [[Jennifer Lopez]].<ref name="Pešić et al. 2014"/>

==Marine species described by Pešić==
The [[World Register of Marine Species]] lists the following species <ref>[http://www.marinespecies.org/aphia.php?p=taxlist WoRMS: Species described by Pešić et al.]</ref>
* ''[[Litarachna antalyaensis]]'' <small>Pešić, Durucan & Chatterjee, 2018</small>
* ''[[Litarachna bruneiensis]]'' <small>Pesic, Chatterjee, Marshall & Pavicevic, 2011</small>
* ''[[Litarachna caribica]]'' <small>Pesic, Chatterjee & Schizas, 2008</small>
* ''[[Litarachna enigmatica]]'' <small>Pešić, Durucan & Chatterjee, 2018</small>
* ''[[Litarachna muratsezgini]]'' <small>Pešić, Durucan & Zawal, 2019</small>
* ''[[Litarachna smiti]]'' <small>Pesic, Chatterjee, Ahmed Abada, 2008</small>
* ''[[Pontarachna arabica]]'' <small>Pesic, Chatterjee & Ahmed Abada, 2008</small>
* ''[[Pontarachna nemethi]]'' <small>Pesic, Chatterjee & Schizas, 2012</small>
* ''[[Pontarachna turcica]]'' <small>Pešić, Durucan & Zawal, 2019</small>
